import os,signal,subprocess,time,unittest
from unittest import mock
from lanes import common
def leaderless_group(member):
 # The leader exits 0 at once and is reaped; `member` stays in its group.
 p=subprocess.Popen(['sh','-c',member+' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null & exit 0'],start_new_session=True,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
 p.wait();return p.pid
class GroupGone(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_waits_for_a_member_that_exits_after_the_leader(self):
  pgid=leaderless_group('sleep 0.5')
  with mock.patch.object(common,'_killpg') as send:
   common._require_group_gone(pgid)
  send.assert_not_called()
 def test_group_that_outlives_the_bound_is_custody_unknown(self):
  pgid=leaderless_group('sleep 30');self.addCleanup(lambda:os.killpg(pgid,signal.SIGKILL))
  with mock.patch.object(common,'GROUP_GONE_TIMEOUT_S',0.2),mock.patch.object(common,'_killpg') as send:
   t=time.monotonic()
   with self.assertRaises(common.CustodyUnknown):common._require_group_gone(pgid)
  self.assertGreaterEqual(time.monotonic()-t,0.2);send.assert_not_called()
 def test_permission_error_does_not_wait(self):
  with mock.patch.object(common.os,'killpg',side_effect=PermissionError),mock.patch.object(common.time,'sleep') as nap:
   with self.assertRaises(common.CustodyUnknown):common._require_group_gone(4242)
  nap.assert_not_called()
 def test_gone_group_returns_at_once(self):
  with mock.patch.object(common.os,'killpg',side_effect=ProcessLookupError),mock.patch.object(common.time,'sleep') as nap:
   common._require_group_gone(4242)
  nap.assert_not_called()
if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
